name: AXM Handoff Wiring Observatory
actions: inventory exact accepts and produces declarations
map exact producer to consumer artifact wiring
separate producer-only consumer-only and self-loop-only declarations
compare authored manifest handoffs with declared contract handoffs
export a wiring map only when an output path is explicit
summary: A deterministic exact-string map of which module artifacts are produced, consumed, self-looped, or unpaired, without inventing schema compatibility or adapters.
notes: Integrated TEST module. Multiple providers are evidence, not a collision; unmatched declarations are seams, not automatic failures.
